caption:
Maiden's Cove Tidal Pool, at its best today.
100% recommended, fully protected right now. 15°C in the water. Grab your towel.

Two sheltered tidal pools among granite boulders between Clifton and Camps Bay, with views of the Twelve Apostles and grassy braai and picnic lawns.
